title: WPSS/2339/2016 of Raghuwant Rawat AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
Modification/Clarification Application (MCC No. 733 of 2019)
And
Impleadment Application (CLMA No. 10684 of 2019)
In
WPSS No. 2339 of 2016
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, Advocate present for the
petitioners.
 Mr. V.D. Bisen, Brief Holder present for the
State/applicant in Modification/Correction
application.
 Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate assisted by
Mr. A.K. Arya, Advocate present for the applicant
in impleadment application.
 For the reasons stated in the impleadment
application, same is allowed.
 This Court had passed an order dated
07.01.2017, where it was simply directed that in the
next selection process for which requisition has
already been made by the State Authorities, 151
posts of last selection year which remained vacant
shall also be included.
 Now a modification application has been
moved by the State praying that State Government
may be permitted to notify the said vacancies in the
advertisement to be issued in the year 2019 for
which requisition has already been sent or permit
the State Government to send a fresh requisition for
151 posts.
 There is no logic or strength in the plea of the
State/applicant in modification/ clarification
application.
 Modification/clarification application is
totally misconceived and is hereby dismissed.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 05.08.2019
Avneet/
